user_story: As a user, I want to update the title of an existing task so that I can correct or clarify it.

positive.title: Update task title successfully with valid data
steps: Navigate to the tasks list page.
Click on the task to open the edit dialog or page.
Enter a valid new title in the title field.
positive.expected_result: The task's title is updated in the task list and displays the new title.

negative.title: Attempt to update task title with an empty string
steps: Navigate to the tasks list page.
Click on the task to open the edit dialog or page.
Clear the title field to leave it empty.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the title cannot be empty, and the task's title remains unchanged.

edge.title: Update task title with maximum allowed length
steps: Navigate to the tasks list page.
Click on the task to open the edit dialog or page.
Enter a new title with exactly the maximum allowed number of characters.
edge.expected_result: The task's title is updated in the task list, is displayed with the full title, and no truncation occurs.
